recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future cleanup of generic DeviceAssociation.relationship binding prose should be handled under a separate DeviceAssociation cleanup issue, not FHIR-48078, because the seed request is already satisfied.
issue_request: FHIR-48078 asked to allow Device.owner to reference Patient, RelatedPerson, and Practitioner for personal and home-use device ownership scenarios. The Applied OO resolution was Not Persuasive with Modification: PHI/sensitive owner data should not be in Device, ownership should be represented in DeviceAssociation, and the DeviceAssociation category/relationship wording should make that clear.
initial_application: No FHIR-48078-tagged source commit was found. The same change family appears to have been applied by FHIR-44840 commits, especially 743a304f21 and cce271e159, which removed active Device.owner, renamed DeviceAssociation.category to DeviceAssociation.relationship, introduced the relationship value set with owner/custodian/patient/operator codes, and added Organization and PractitionerRole while retaining Patient, Practitioner, and RelatedPerson in DeviceAssociation.subject.
additional_context: FHIR-44840 and FHIR-37999 are the closely related ownership decisions. Current source/fhir.ini has Device and DeviceAssociation active in the build. Current Device narrative and the device module state that Device.owner moved to DeviceAssociation.relationship, DeviceAssociation narrative says ownership/custodianship should use DeviceAssociation, and the relationship code system includes owner. OO Confluence minutes record the March 2025 FHIR-48078 block vote and the HCP rationale for moving ownership out of Device to avoid sensitive owner data in the Device resource.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined branch. The current source already conveys the approved rule through active conformance definitions, terminology, and narrative, so adding another local comment would be redundant and would not change implementer understanding.
